question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. No one sits to the right of G. Only four people sit between E and F. C sits fifth from the right end of the row. B sits to the immediate right of A but left of E. How many people sit to the right of D?
solution:
Given: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

 
• No one sits to the right of G.
 
• Only four people sit between E and F.
 
• C sits fifth from the right end of the row.
 
• B sits to the immediate right of A but left of E

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5954a8543a7d1dc971679d0efee60fcd7d32845be3d687368ee78e5f2295dedd.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
